players.bio: Alfonso Trezza Hernández (born 22 June 1999) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a winger for Primeira Liga club Arouca.
Arnau Solà Mateu (born 4 April 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Villarreal CF B, on loan from UD Almería.

Boris Popović (born 26 February 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Primeira Liga club Arouca on loan from Belgian club Cercle Brugge. Born in France, he was a youth international for Serbia.
Brian Nicolás Mansilla Islas (born 14 May 2002) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga club Arouca, on loan from Peñarol.
David Martins Simão (born 15 May 1990) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club F.C. Arouca.

Fally N'Dofunsu Mayulu (born 15 July 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship side Bristol City. Mayulu passed through the academies of Epinay and Entente SSG before joining Lens. After three years with Lens, he went on trial with Paris Saint-Germain, but would ultimately end up joining German side VfL Wolfsburg.
Ignacio de Arruabarrena Fernández (born 16 January 1997) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Saudi Pro League club Al Wehda.
Iván Martínez Gonzálvez (born 17 August 1998), known as Iván Barbero or simply Barbero, is a Spanish footballer who plays as a forward for Deportivo de La Coruña.
Jakub Vinarcik (born 11 July 2005), is a Slovakian footballer who plays as a Goalkeeper for Portuguese club Arouca, on loan from Juve Next Gen.
Javier Sánchez de Felipe (born 14 March 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Real Valladolid, on loan from Real Madrid. And Spanish national team.
João Nuno Figueiredo Valido (born 28 April 2001) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Arouca.
José Manuel Fontán Mondragón (born 11 February 2000) is a Spanish footballer who plays as either a left-back or a centre-back for Portuguese club FC Arouca.
Leo Oren Shahar (born 18 March 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Newcastle United.
Mateo Flores Lozano (born 7 April 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Betis Deportivo Balompié.
Miguel Puche García (born 30 April 2001) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a winger for Portuguese club FC Arouca.
Naïs Djouahra (born 23 November 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Croatian club Rijeka.
Nino Galović (born 6 July 1992) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays for F.C. Arouca in Portugal as a centre-back.
Orest Lebedenko (Ukrainian: Орест Зіновійович Лебеденко; born 23 September 1998) is a professional Ukrainian football defender who currently plays for club CD Lugo in the Segunda División.

Pablo Gozálbez Gilabert (born 30 April 2001) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Portuguese club FC Arouca. Born in Canet d'en Berenguer, Valencian Community, Gozálbez joined Valencia CF's youth setup in 2007, aged eight.
Pedro Carvalho Santos (born 12 October 2000) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Arouca.
Pedro Manuel da Silva Moreira (born 15 March 1989) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for F.C. Arouca.
Taichi Fukui (born 15 July 2004) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Arouca.

Tiago Alexandre Sousa Esgaio (born 1 August 1995) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for Primeira Liga club F.C. Arouca mainly as a right-back. Club career Belenenses Born in Nazaré, Leiria District, played youth football for three clubs. He made his senior debut in the third division, spending one season apiece with Caldas S.C. and S.C.U. Torreense.
